title: Distributed Backtester Worker Error
description: Worker-to-coordinator failure report. Use it when a message cannot be processed, or when the worker cannot produce a backtest_result for a readable job. Per-job strategy and data failures still use backtest_result with status invalid or failed.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema, for editor support.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.

message_id.description: Echoed when the envelope was readable; omitted otherwise.

worker_id.description: Worker identity, for logs and diagnostics.

path.description: JSONPath-like location of the invalid field, when known.
